_comment: Clock-gating units for TI's RTL (tools/check-cg.py, docs/rtl-coding-style.md 'Local clock gating'). rpt is a lane-sized repeater, two stages of one 344-bit slot: the module's own unit; every repeater the design instantiates is a unit of its own too (rtl/top/rpt-units.json), and the selftest shows what a lead slice costs one (test/cg/fixtures/rpt-units.json). A unit is one module at one parameterization with a bench that runs the idle, medium and high scenarios and dumps a VCD; the bench's port trace is replayed into the unit's netlist. {dir} is the unit's bench build directory, {scenario} and {vcd} the run's.

bench.build: verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=2 -GS=1 -GW=344 "-GLEAD=344'h0" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv

verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_clk --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/ctech/sim/ccv_common_ctech_icg.sv rtl/clk/ccv_common_clk.sv test/cg/tb_cg_clk.sv
